headword: {品質保証|ひんしつほしょう}

definitions.explanation: The systematic process of ensuring that a product or service meets defined standards of quality, or a formal guarantee that a product will perform as expected. Widely used in manufacturing and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}{部門|ぶもん}に{配属|はいぞく}された。
examples.english: I was assigned to the quality assurance department.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}には{品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}がついている。
examples.english: This product comes with a quality guarantee.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}の{基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たさない{製品|せいひん}は{出荷|しゅっか}できない。
examples.english: Products that do not meet quality assurance standards cannot be shipped.

notes:
A compound of {品質|ひんしつ} (quality) and {保証|ほしょう} (guarantee/assurance). Used extensively in manufacturing, business, and product contexts. In corporate settings, often abbreviated as QA. Japan's manufacturing culture places great emphasis on quality assurance processes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}{部門|ぶもん}: quality assurance department
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}{体制|たいせい}: quality assurance system
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}{書|しょ}: certificate of quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり} — quality control (QC); focuses on inspection and control processes
- {保証|ほしょう}{書|しょ} — warranty certificate; a document guaranteeing a product
- {品質|ひんしつ}{検査|けんさ} — quality inspection; the testing stage specifically
